regions.finding: Background discussion and citations about allenes and cyclooctanoid synthesis; no current-paper experiment is instantiated from this region.

Three displayed condition/result lines were inspected. The 170 °C/9.5 h sealed and 80 °C/6 h experiments are separate optimization records; the 100 °C/6 h/89% line is the same experiment as Table 1 entry 1 and is not duplicated.

regions.region: middle- and lower-right Table 1 including footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Fifteen substrate-scope rows were transcribed as independent records. Common argon/scale/xylene/100 °C/6 h conditions were applied row-wise; entry 2 uses 7 h, entries 4 and 9 include the approximately 10 wt% unidentified byproduct, and entry 15 uses 90 °C/2 h.

regions.region: lower-left prose describing mechanistic control experiments
regions.finding: The prose reports the three Scheme 2 controls (1f + 3, 2f + 3, and 1g + 3); each record is linked to both this prose and the page-2 scheme rather than duplicated across pages.

regions.region: bottom-right prose beginning discussion of proposed pathways
regions.finding: Mechanistic interpretation continues onto page 2; it is treated as a proposed mechanism, not as an additional reported experiment.

unresolved: The complex displayed substrate and product structures were not transcribed to SMILES; their labels and original drawings are retained.
Yield measurement basis, workup, and purification are not stated in the supplied main-text pages.
The paper announces Supporting Information, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.finding: ORTEP structures for 2ab and 4g are characterization evidence, not separate reaction experiments.

Three independent controls were recorded: 1f + 2.0 equiv 3 at 55 °C for 24 h gives 2f (48%) and 4f (26%); 2f + 2.0 equiv 3 at 55 °C for 24 h gives 4f (53%) with 28% 2f recovered; 1g + 2.0 equiv 3 at 55 °C for 21.5 h gives 4g (77%).
The two proposed routes via intermediates 6/5 or 7 and the trapping of 5 by dienophile 3 were captured as one mechanism record, not as experimentally isolated intermediates.

regions.region: lower-left conclusion and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: Conclusion summarizes the method. The text says experimental procedures and characterization data are available as SI, but no SI document is present in the supplied dataset, so no association was inferred.

regions.region: right column references and crystallographic footnotes
regions.finding: Prior literature and crystal data were inspected as contextual/characterization material and were not instantiated as current-paper reaction experiments.
